findings.reason: Instance of a Trojan trigger module that monitors the 128-bit state input for a specific sequence of rare values to activate a trigger signal.
Trigger signal activated only when a specific sequence of four 128-bit state values is detected, used to capture and leak the secret key.
Trojan side-channel module that captures the secret key upon trigger activation and leaks it bit-by-bit through a power/delay-based inverter chain.
State register used to track the sequential detection of rare 128-bit input patterns to activate the Trojan trigger.
